generalCriterionList.description: Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by any State Government Government of India /Union Territory
Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of KPP Portal on or before the last date and time of bid submission.

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
Conditional Tenders are liable to be rejected .The Employer reserves the right to Reject any or all Tenders without assigning any reason
All relevant documents as per the KW-6 need to be uploaded while submitting bid in general documents provision in KPP portal
The Employer reserves the right to accept or reject any or all the tenders without assigning any reason whatsoever

The contractor has to make his own arrangements for procurement of all the required materials and the materials so procured shall confirm to the relevant IS Specifications or Equivalent and obtain necessary quality certificate from authorized quality control.
The Contractor is fully responsible for the Equipment / Material / Project, until the same is handed over to the EXECUTIVE ENGINEER in an operating condition after commissioning.

The Contractor is responsible for the proper maintenance of equipment /material / Project, as well as protection of the same against theft, elements of nature, damages etc while in his custody as well as after erection until the same is taken over by the EXECUTIVE ENGINEER under due acknowledgment in writing.
The contractor should furnish the name of the individual/ firm/company joint venture with address, telephone number, fax number, e-mail address with place of registration, year of incorporation etc.
The certificates furnished by the bidder shall be got confirmed / verified for its genuineness

The intending Bidders/firms/companies/ joint ventures are advised to visit the site of work, make themselves familiar with local situation about the availability of the construction materials, workmen, land required for construction activities etc
The bidder should enclose the detailed methodology of execution of the scheme as per the scope of work
If any of the dates mentioned above happens to be a general holiday, the next working day holds good.
All materials of approved quality including steel, cement etc., required for the above work should be procured by the contractor only. No departmental supply of any materials shall be made.
Typographical errors, if any, will not be the ground for any claims by the bidder/ firm/company/ joint venture.

The agency should establish temporary material testing lab at the location of the work site with all required facilities and logbooks are to be maintained in prescribed format of Quality control Reports And submit same to the Department Regularly.
The Period of completion is 11 months (including Monsoon).

The Tenders are invited as per standard tender bid documents K/W-6. The intending bidder/ firm/company/ joint venture should adhere to all terms & conditions in the tender documents, Standard Specifications, and prevailing Government orders/ circulars

Water arrangement for the construction, curing, drinking for the construction staff, etc. is in the scope of the bidder/ firm/company/ joint venture. Temporary/permanent accommodation for the staff and workers is also in the scope of the bidder/ firm/company/ joint venture.
Disposal of debris / unused excavated stuff including transportation and with all lead & lifts is in the scope of the bidder/ firm/company/ joint venture.
Safety measures, barricading, traffic management, etc. at work sites are in the scope of the bidder/ firm/company/ joint venture

Any other items of work that have not been specifically mentioned in the specifications but are necessary for the Project as per good engineering practice, safety norms, and operation & maintenance, shall be deemed to be included within the scope of work.

The Bidder/ firm/company/ joint venture should submit documentary records like photos, videos, etc. of the existing condition of the items covered under the General Scope of Work, during, and after the execution of the work

During the execution, any existing structures, etc., disturbed should be restored to their original condition as directed by the engineer in charge with approved drawings by the competent authorities by the contractor at the contractors cost.
All the cost towards measures to be taken by the bidder/ firm/company/ joint venture for dewatering necessary for the execution of the work is deemed to be included in the bid price.

Creating Documentation of day-to-day activities and submitting the same to the Department regularly, such as Photos/Videos, Progress/Other Reports, Log-books, History Sheets, Inventory Register, Correspondence Files, As-Built Drawings, Operation& Maintenance Manuals, list of fast wearing spares and stock of spares for minimum one year of normal operation shall be maintained.

The bidder/ firm/company/ joint venture should provide the required safety measures and train all concerned staff in day-to-day operations. The bidder/ firm/company/ joint venture shall comply with all applicable health and safety regulations in all activities of the Scheme. The bidder/ firm/company/ joint venture is responsible for ensuring the health & safety of his personnel
Sufficient stock of consumables for daily maintenance of electrical and mechanical components shall always be maintained at all the required locations.

The bidder/ firm/company/ joint venture shall plan adequately for any accidents to the personnel and all statutory requirements according to the Labour Act shall be provided to the concerned personnel.
A Complaint Register shall be maintained along with the Follow-up details, for recording complaints, and actions taken shall be maintained in prescribed formats.

Any activity not specifically mentioned herein but deemed to be fairly contingent to the intent and spirit of contracted work as per the Engineer in charge will form part of the responsibility of the Contractor.
The bidder/ firm/company/ joint venture should adhere to the latest version of relevant IS standards which are applicable for all designs/execution/testing & commissioning etc. for this works.
The Prevailing Common SR shall be referred for the detailed specifications for all the works under the Scope of Work.

The bidder is required to ensure browser compatibility of the computer well in advance to the last date and time for receipt of tenders The departments shall not be responsible for non accessibility of KPPP portal due to internet connectivity issues and technical glitches at bidders end
EMD Payments through KPP portal mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection
Bidder shall pay Contract Management Module processing fees of 0.025% of the contact value (Min Rs.500/- & Max Rs.7500/-) soon after contract has been issued to bidder

Royalty on construction materials and other taxes will be deducted as per prevailing Govt orders. Royalty shall be deducted as per KMMCR 1994 Amendment rule 2016, Also KMMCR 2016 Amendment Rule 36(3), 42(1), 44(3), 44(4)
The cost of the Tender form shall not be refundable.

As per Karnataka State Govt Order No:LD/300/LET/2006/Bangalore Dt:1-1-2007 and Govt Ltr No:PW/134/BMS/2007, Dt: 27-7-2007, a sum amounting to 1% of the bill amount will be deducted towards Construction Labour Welfare fund.
Financial Year will be reckoned as the period between first day of April and Thirty first day of March of succeeding year (both days inclusive).

The tenderer shall furnish required information in all formats. Scan and upload all Formats/Original documents required for this bid to the KPP portal. The Original Formats/Documents shall be produced at the time of opening of Technical Bid for physical verification.

If any additions/alteration of location involved during execution, it is the responsibility of the agency to execute the work as per contemplated scope of the work, without causing any damages to existing infrastructure. If any damages occur during execution, the same shall be restored to the original condition at no extra cost
The individual bidders of joint venture should be Class I Contractor registered in Karnataka PWD/Central PWD separately

The tenderer has to quote his rates by excluding GST. However Contract will be concluded for the amount (exclusive of GST) but applicable GST will be paid extra prevailing at the time of execution. If the GST rates are revised during the Contract period. The tenderer/Employer has to accept the revised GST rates for making payment/recovery.
Addendum / Corrigendum will be published in the website for all modifications or corrections if any

technicalCriterionList.description: Satisfactory completion (at least 90% of the contract value), as Prime contractor, at least one similar work such as Construction / Improvements of tanks from Single Contract of value not less than Rs.895.69 Lakhs during the last five years (2021-22 to 2025-26).The work done certificate should be obtained duly signed from an Officer not below the rank of Executive Engineer of the concerned division. (Workdone of previous years shall be given a weightage of 10% per year to bring them to the price level of FY 2026-27)

To qualify for award of this contract, each Tenderer in its name should have in the last five years i.e. (2020-21, 2021-22, 2022-23, 2023-24 & 2024-25) Executed in any one year the minimum quantities of work: 1) Earth work(Excavation, Embankment) etc 825643.00 Cum, 2) Cement concrete (including RCC & PCC) 1782.00Cum,3) Steel works for RCC (Reinforcement Steel) 73.00 Tonne 4) Stone pitching/Revetment 16738.00 sqm
Reports on the financial standing of the tenderer, Such as profit and loss statements and auditors reports for the last five year

Each Tenderer should further demonstrate (a) Availability by owning at least 50% of the required / specified key and critical equipment for this work and the remaining 50% can be deployed on lease/ hire basis for all works provided, the relevant documents (Bidder has to upload the Scanned Copies of Original Commitment agreements, RC book, Purchase invoice, sale deed, hire/lease deed, latest Bextracts, latest insurance copy etc.,) for availability for this work are furnished. A) Availability by owing the following key and critical equipment for the work. Excavator REQUIRED 03 NOs OWN 01NOs HIRE 02NOs Lorry / Tippers REQUIRED 3NOs OWN 1NOs HIRE 2NOs Self loading Concrete Mixer REQUIRED 03NOs OWN 1NOs HIRE 02NOs
List of existing commitments and ongoing works
EPF & ESI Registration Certificate & Previous month ESI Payment challan.

To qualify for award of this contract, each Tenderer in its name should have in the last five years i.e. (( 2021-22, 2022-23, 2023-24 ,2024-25 &2025-26). Achieved in at least two financial years a minimum financial turnover of Rs.3582.77 Lakhs.(Financial Turn over of previous years shall be given a weightage of 10% per year to bring them to the price level of FY 2026-27).

itemList.description: Cutting and burning or disposing off Apu / Jondu from marshy areas as directed with all other ancillary operations complete-complete with all lead and lifts including loading and unloading and as per specification with the directions of Engineer-in-charge of work.

Cutting and removing jauliflora bushes upto 1.50 m girth excluding removal of stumps and including burning or disposing off the materials as directed with all other ancillary operations complete. 
-complete with all lead and lifts including loading and unloading and as per specification with the directions of Engineer-in-charge of work.

Earth work excavation for Foundation by mechanical means for all works & depth upto 3 m, as per drawing and technical specifications, including setting out, shoring, strutting, barricading, caution lights, including dressing of excavated surfaces, disposing off or levelling the excavated earth or sorting & stacking the selected earth for reuse in a radius of 50 m and lift upto 1.5 m including cost of labour, tools, usage of machinery & other appurtenaces required to complete the work. -complete with all lead and lifts including loading and unloading and as per specification with the directions of Engineer-in-charge of work.

Earth work excavation for Foundation by mechanical means for all works & depth upto 3 m, as per drawing and technical specifications, including setting out, shoring, strutting, barricading, caution lights, including dressing of excavated surfaces, disposing off or levelling the excavated earth or sorting & stacking the selected earth for reuse in a radius of 50 m and lift upto 1.5 m including cost of labour, tools, usage of machinery & other appurtenaces required to complete the work. In ordinary / soft rock without blasting upto 1.5m depth.-complete with all lead and lifts including loading and unloading and as per specification with the directions of Engineer-in-charge of work.

Providing cut-off trench filling using selected approved impervious soil from borrow areas in layers of 250 to 300 mm (before compaction) including cost of all materials, machinery, labour, all other operations such as collection of soil, spreading soil in layer of specified thickness, sorting out, breaking clods, levelling, sectioning edges / sides, watering, compacting to density control of not less than 95 percent using power roller and all other ancillary operations complete.-complete with all lead and lifts including loading and unloading and as per specification with the directions of Engineer-in-charge of work.

Providing and laying in position Reinforced cement concrete for all Sub structures of building, Irrigation works, Sub structure works of bridges, Drain works & other parallel works from 0.50m to 3.50 m height. The granite/trap/basalt crushed graded coarse aggregates and fine aggregates as per relevant IS Codes machine mixed with super plasticisers, laid in layers, well compacted using needle vibrators, providing weep holes wherever necesary, including all lead & lifts, cost of all materials of quality, confirming to the requirements of relevant IS codes, labour, Usage charges of machinery, curing and all other appurtenances required to complete the work as per technical specifications. (The cost of steel reinforcement & formwork to be paid separately) M20 Design Mix Using 20 mm nominal size graded crushed coarse aggregates.-complete with all lead and lifts including loading and unloading and as per specification with the directions of Engineer-in-charge of work.

Supplying, fitting and placing TMT FE 550 / 550D Steel Reinforcement including cost of all materials, machinery, labour, cleaning, straightening, cutting, bending, hooking, laping/welding joints, tying with binding wire / soft annealed steel wire and other ancilary operations complete as per drawing and technical specification.-complete with all lead and lifts including loading and unloading and as per specification with the directions of Engineer-in-charge of work.

Providing hearting embankment using impervious soil collected in embankment area in heaps as part of disposal of excavated soil from canal in layers of 250 to 300 mm thickness (before compaction), including cost of all materials, machinery, labour, all other operations such as spreading soil in layer of specified thickness, sorting-out, breaking clods, levelling, sectioning edges / sides, watering , compacting each layer to density control of not less than 95 percent or as stipulated using power roller and all other ancillary operations complete.-complete with all lead and lifts including loading and unloading and as per specification with the directions of Engineer-in-charge of work.

Providing and constructing vertical/inclined graded filter media using clean, hard graded sand and coarse aggregates from approved source satisfying specified filter criteria in layers of specified thickness including cost of all materials, machinery, labour, laying to required slopes, compacting and all other ancillary operations complete as per specifications and approved drawings.-complete with all lead and lifts including loading and unloading and as per specification with the directions of Engineer-in-charge of work.

Providing casing embankment using semi-pervious / pervious soil collected in embankment area in heaps as part of disposal of excavated soil from canal in layer of 250 to 300 mm (before compaction) including cost of all materials,machinery, labour,all other operations such as spreading soil in layer of specified thickness, sorting-out, breaking clods, levelling, sectioning edges / sides, watering, compacting each layer to density control of not less than 95 percent or as stipulated by power roller and all other ancillary operations complete.-complete with all lead and lifts including loading and unloading and as per specification with the directions of Engineer-in-charge of work.

Providing and constructing dry rubble rock-toe using rubble and stone chips from approved source including cost of all materials, machinery, labour, hand packing rubble and stone chips, finishing top and sides to required slopes as per approved drawings and all other ancillary operations complete. complete with all lead and lifts including loading and unloading and as per specification with the directions of Engineer-in-charge of work.

Providing and constructing longitudinal / cross graded filter drains using sand, 80mm to 20 mm and 20 mm down clean, hard graded aggregates from approved source satisfying specified filter criteria in layers of specified thickness including cost of all materials, machinery, labour, laying to required slopes, compaction and all other ancillary operations complete as per specifications and approved drawings. complete with all lead and lifts including loading and unloading and as per specification with the directions of Engineer-in-charge of work.

Providing and constructing 450 mm thick hand packed rough stone revetment consisting of 300 mm thick rough stones with 400 to 450 mm long through stones at 1.5 m c / c over a backing of 150 mm thick 40 mm down graded coarse aggregate layer including cost of all materials machinery, labour, laying to specified slope, wedging with chips, finishing & all necessary works as directed and complete as per specification. complete with all lead and lifts including loading and unloading and as per specification with the directions of Engineer-in-charge of work.

Spec.
